tickerText: [TENNIS] Alexandra Eala stunned Naomi Osaka 6-4, 6-2 to reach the Washington Open final against Jessica Pegula, while Taylor Fritz beat Brandon Nakashima 6-3, 3-6, 6-3 in the men's semis • [SQUASH] Pakistan's Hamza Khan and Nasir Iqbal reached the PN Fleet Club Open quarter-finals with seed upsets as the 2026/27 PSA season opens in Karachi • [BADMINTON] 17-year-old Tanvi Sharma faces Nguyen Thuy Linh in the Taipei Open final after becoming the youngest women's singles finalist in tournament history • [PICKLEBALL] The Wisconsin PPA Challenger concludes in Lake Hallie today ahead of the PPA Asia 500 Ho Chi Minh City Open on August 6–9 • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Champions Yokohama begins August 4 at the BUNTAI in Japan, while tickets are now on sale for WTT Champions Macao September 8–13

newsItems.title: Eala Stuns Osaka in DC
newsItems.excerpt: Alexandra Eala upset Naomi Osaka 6-4, 6-2 to reach her first WTA 500 final at the Washington Open, where she will face top seed Jessica Pegula on Sunday.

newsItems.title: Pakistan Duo Stars in Karachi
newsItems.excerpt: Hamza Khan and Nasir Iqbal delighted home crowds with quarter-final upsets at the PN Fleet Club Open, the first World Event of the new PSA Squash Tour season.

newsItems.title: Tanvi's Taipei Final Run
newsItems.excerpt: At 17, Tanvi Sharma became the youngest Taipei Open women's singles finalist ever and will face Nguyen Thuy Linh on Sunday chasing her maiden BWF World Tour title.

newsItems.title: Wisconsin Challenger Wraps
newsItems.excerpt: The Wisconsin PPA Challenger concludes today in Lake Hallie as the tour shifts to Asia, with the PPA Asia 500 Ho Chi Minh City Open set for August 6–9.
